title: Pro-x
wikitext:
== Description == Pro-X is a slightly modified version of the original [[Clan Arena]] Mod. Originally it was created as rocket arena hybrid that allows players to join different arena's in 1v1 battles where everyone starts with the same health,armor,and weapons along with arena's for team play. Unlike the original [[CACE]], Pro-X includes hitsounds, name tagging, and sudden death built into a variety of maps. == Installation == AS of 2013, Pro-X is known to work better using [[FTE]] server.
Here's an example of a linux command line to enable Pro-X, with an "prox" folder in linux:
 ./fteqw.sv -port 27500 +gamedir prox +exec qw_server.cfg
Notice the +gamedir. == Leagues == [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[claw]] started the first clan arena league called [[Fusion (league)]] incorporating Pro-X into the tournament. == Developers == * Ben [[Electro]] Darling (co-Creator of [[Reflex Arena]]) * [[Lord Havoc]] == See also == * [[Clan Arena]] * [[Fusion (league)]] [[Category:Game modes]]
